 __
 
• **Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal in the javelin throw event at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.**
 
• **He is the first Indian athlete to win a gold medal in athletics at the Olympics.**
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's winning throw of 87.58 m was also a national record for India.**
 

 
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra is an athlete from the state of Haryana.**

 
 
• **He started his career as a wrestler but later switched to javelin throw.**
 
• **He has won several medals in international competitions, including gold medals at the 2018 Commonwealth Games and the 2018 Asian Games.**
 
• **He is the first Asian athlete to win an Olympic gold medal in javelin and the first Asian to win gold in his event at the World Championship.**
